Aleppo

Aleppo has no meteg after the silluq at 1 Kgs. 14:14.

St. Petersburg EVR-II-B-55

St. Petersburg EVR-II-B-55 (formerly B 247), identified in MAM by the siglum ל-א, is a manuscript of the Prophets and Writings close to the Aleppo Codex. At 1 Kgs. 14:14 it has the silluq alone in this word.
